entities.name: Mạc Cửu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mạc Cửu, also spelled Mok Kui, was an exile from China who founded the Principality of Hà Tiên and ruled as its first monarch. He played a role in the relations between Cambodia and the Vietnamese Nguyễn court.
